candidates.change_summary: Remove the overflow check in require statement by deleting the require line.
Change the unlockTime assignment to always use block.timestamp, ignoring _unlockTime.
Change the unlockTime assignment to always use _unlockTime, ignoring block.timestamp.
Insert a line that resets acc.balance to 0 before adding msg.value.
Delete the line that updates acc.balance with msg.value.
Change the balance increment to use a constant value (1 wei) instead of msg.value.
Replace the require condition with a constant false, making the function always revert.
Remove the block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime check so Collect succeeds regardless of unlock time.
Remove the acc.balance >= MinSum check so Collect succeeds even when balance is below MinSum.
Replace acc.balance >= _am with true so Collect always proceeds regardless of amount requested.
Change acc.balance - _am subtraction to addition so balance increases on collect instead of decreases.
Change the IF condition line 18 from `acc.balance>=MinSum` to `acc.balance>MinSum`, so a balance exactly equal to MinSum no longer allows Collect.
Change the IF condition line 18 from `block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime` to `block.timestamp>=acc.unlockTime`, so Collect can succeed exactly at unlockTime.
Change the subtraction line 21 from `acc.balance - _am` to `acc.balance - (_am - 1)`, changing the post-Collect balance after the external call.
Move the state update `acc.balance = (acc.balance - _am);` from BEFORE the external call to AFTER it, so the callee observes the old balance during the call.
Change the success-handling IF condition on line 22 from checking `_s` to `_s && false`, forcing revert after a successful external call.
Change the low-level external call value on line 22 from `_am` to `0`, so Collect succeeds without transferring the requested amount.
Change the Collect balance guard from acc.balance>=MinSum to acc.balance>MinSum, rejecting calls where the balance exactly equals MinSum.
Change the Collect amount guard from acc.balance>=_am to acc.balance>_am, requiring a strictly larger balance than the requested amount.
Change the unlock-time guard from block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime to block.timestamp>=acc.unlockTime, allowing collection at the exact unlock time.
Change the balance update from subtracting _am to adding _am, so a successful Collect increases the stored balance instead.
Move the acc.balance subtraction from before the external call to after it, leaving the state unchanged while the callee runs.
